entries.e782b66acadad013: It mainly provides microcontrollers, SoCs, analog semiconductors and power semiconductors for both automotive and industrial, infrastructure and IoT applications. The company cites as a strength its combination of products it calls the “Winning Combination,” which pairs microcontrollers and SoCs (digital) that handle computation, analog devices that handle sensing (the equivalent of human eyes and ears), and power devices that drive motors and the like.
entries.ee6870102457e899: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,321.2 billion, a decline of ¥27.3 billion (2.0%) from the previous year.
entries.eed8b0394dbf6c9d: It supplies semiconductors that control automobile engines, vehicle bodies and other components.
entries.fb53e7fb670e541c: As a dedicated semiconductor manufacturer, it conducts research, development, design, manufacturing, sales and services related to various semiconductors. These functions are divided between Renesas itself and its subsidiaries: research, development and design are carried out by overseas subsidiaries such as Renesas Electronics America and Renesas Design Vietnam as well as by Renesas itself, while manufacturing is mainly carried out by production subsidiaries in Japan and overseas, and external production contractors such as [[term:foundry|foundry]] are also used as needed. Revenue is mainly from sales of semiconductor products and is recognized when the products are delivered to customers. In Japan, it sells mainly through partner sales distributors, and overseas it sells mainly through overseas sales subsidiaries and distributors.
